title: Suboptimal MPLS Path — pe1 eth1 OSPF cost inflated
symptom: DC1 to campus1 traffic taking suboptimal path. pe1 should route via p1 (eth1) as primary but traffic is going via eth2 instead.
root_cause: OSPF metric set to 1000 on pe1 eth1 (toward p1) — pe1 prefers eth2 path causing asymmetric routing
fix_command: delete protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface eth1 metric
